macro.title: United ditches flight segments, raises bar for 1K in Premier status shakeup - The Points Guy
macro.summary: United will stop counting the number of flights its MileagePlus members take and instead require them to focus on spending-based PQPs for status.

macro.title: Social Security chief Bisignano says program will 'be around for another 90 years' - Fox Business
macro.summary: Social Security Administration Commissioner Frank Bisignano says the program will last another 90 years even as the trust fund nears insolvency.

macro.title: S&P 500 closes near flat after big banks post earnings and memory chip stocks decline - CNBC
macro.summary: Traders digested a slew of corporate earnings reports from major banks along with a steep overnight decline in South Korea that put pressure on memory names.
